name: Safekeeping Place 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of place of safekeeping.

CUST.name: Shares Held At Local Custodian
CUST.definition: Financial instruments held at a local custodian.

ICSD.name: Shares Held At ICSD
ICSD.definition: Financial instruments held at an International Central Securities Depository.

NCSD.name: Shares Held At NCSD
NCSD.definition: Financial instruments held at a National Central Securities Depository.

SHHE.name: Shares Held Elsewhere
SHHE.definition: Used for certain financial instruments, for example, US mutual funds, where settlement is internal only, that is, there is no external movement of securities.
